item.title: Bloomington Boogies 2026 Concert — Sun Oct 11, 3:00 PM — Buskirk-Chumley Theater
item.description:
Tickets go on sale August 11th!
The 8th Bloomington Boogies Concert features acclaimed musicians who play blues piano, boogie-woogie, stride and other jazz forms, and zydeco accordion. New artists include Jason Marsalis (vibes/drums), Deanna Bogart (piano/sax), Yoshi Z2 Tsuji, and special guest Silvan Zingg; returning favorites include Rob Rio, Sunpie Barnes (accordion) with Matt Hampsey (guitar) of Sunpie & the Louisiana Sunspots, and Dr. Keith McCutchen, plus the rhythm section: Gordon Bonham (guitar), Joe Donnelly (sax), Ron Kadish (bass), and Dan Hostetler (drums).
Bloomington Boogies has been voted a top 10 festival in Indiana. Its mission is to present world-class performers in Bloomington, and to introduce young people to artists and musical styles through public concerts and free educational activities, including school performances, workshops, and master classes. See a complete list of festival activities at https://bloomingtonboogies.com/home https://bloomingtonboogies.com/

item.title: New Exhibitions at the Brown County Art Guild! — Mon Oct 12, 3:00 PM — Brown County Art Guild
item.description:
July 24 – November 7, 2026 Guild Artist Exhibition and Sale
Summer brings fresh inspiration, and our Guild Artists have been busy creating new work to share. Discover new landscapes, still lifes, contemporary works, and more as you explore the Guild Galleries. Whether you’re an avid collector, art enthusiast, or simply looking for inspiration, this exhibition offers a wonderful opportunity to experience the creativity that continues to thrive in Brown County.
July 24 – November 7, 2026 The Art of Brown County – Scenes & Views Special Exhibition & Sale
The Art of Brown County – Scenes & Views is a special exhibition and sale that celebrates the familiar vistas, treasured locations, and fresh perspectives that honor both the natural beauty and rich artistic heritage of the area. Find the places you love reflected in original works by the artists of the Brown County Art Guild. Every painting tells a story of Brown County & Nashville, Indiana with color, light and texture. ———————————

item.title: Brown County Art Guild 2026 Annual Raffle — Tue Oct 13, 12:00 PM — Brown County Art Guild
item.description: Take a chance to win ‘Painters Point’, a beautiful original oil painting generously donated by Guild Artist, Allen Hutton. He strives to render the fleeting patterns of light and shadow with the simple purpose of preserving the reality of a landscape at a particular moment in time and season. Allen has achieved numerous awards and his art can be found in both private and corporate collections across the county. Tickets: 1 for $30, 2 for $50, or 5 for $100 Your generosity helps the Guild to preserve its historic collection, promote its award-winning artist members, and offer workshops and programs throughout the year! The drawing of the winning raffle ticket will be held at 3pm on Saturday, November 21, 2026, at the Guild. The winner need not be present for the drawing. Purchase options: In person at the Guild, call 812-988-6185 or purchase raffle tickets at: https://browncountyartguild.org/product/brown-county-art-guild-annual-raffle/ ——————————————————————————————————

item.title: Trivia Night (21+) — Wed Oct 14, 10:00 PM
item.description:
Test your knowledge and enjoy a fun night out at Trivia Night hosted weekly at Moontown Brewing Company in downtown Nashville! Gather your friends, grab a craft beer, and compete in five rounds of trivia covering everything from pop culture and history to music, movies, and more. Free to play and open to teams of any size, this lively weekly event is perfect for both serious trivia buffs and casual players looking for a fun midweek outing. Prizes are awarded to the top teams, and Moontown’s relaxed atmosphere, local brews, and great food make it an ideal spot to unwind and connect with friends in Brown County. Trivia takes place Wednesdays from 6–8 PM.
Source: Brown County Events

item.title: Brown County Art Guild 2026 Annual Raffle — Sat Oct 17, 12:00 PM — Brown County Art Guild
item.description: Take a chance to win ‘Painters Point’, a beautiful original oil painting generously donated by Guild Artist, Allen Hutton. He strives to render the fleeting patterns of light and shadow with the simple purpose of preserving the reality of a landscape at a particular moment in time and season. Allen has achieved numerous awards and his art can be found in both private and corporate collections across the county. Tickets: 1 for $30, 2 for $50, or 5 for $100 Your generosity helps the Guild to preserve its historic collection, promote its award-winning artist members, and offer workshops and programs throughout the year! The drawing of the winning raffle ticket will be held at 3pm on Saturday, November 21, 2026, at the Guild. The winner need not be present for the drawing. Purchase options: In person at the Guild, call 812-988-6185 or purchase raffle tickets at: https://browncountyartguild.org/product/brown-county-art-guild-annual-raffle/ ——————————————————————————————————

item.title: New Exhibitions at the Brown County Art Guild! — Sat Oct 17, 3:00 PM — Brown County Art Guild
item.description:
July 24 – November 7, 2026 Guild Artist Exhibition and Sale
Summer brings fresh inspiration, and our Guild Artists have been busy creating new work to share. Discover new landscapes, still lifes, contemporary works, and more as you explore the Guild Galleries. Whether you’re an avid collector, art enthusiast, or simply looking for inspiration, this exhibition offers a wonderful opportunity to experience the creativity that continues to thrive in Brown County.
July 24 – November 7, 2026 The Art of Brown County – Scenes & Views Special Exhibition & Sale
The Art of Brown County – Scenes & Views is a special exhibition and sale that celebrates the familiar vistas, treasured locations, and fresh perspectives that honor both the natural beauty and rich artistic heritage of the area. Find the places you love reflected in original works by the artists of the Brown County Art Guild. Every painting tells a story of Brown County & Nashville, Indiana with color, light and texture. ———————————
